## Welcome

This lesson introduces the tools we will use throughout the course: Quarto, Git, and NIMBLE.

## Quarto Resources

[Quarto](https://quarto.org/) is a scientific publishing system that lets you combine code, text, and output into reproducible documents.

- **Getting started with Quarto in RStudio**: <https://quarto.org/docs/get-started/hello/rstudio.html>
- **Quarto for Scientists**: <https://qmd4sci.njtierney.com/>

## Git

[Git](https://git-scm.com/) is a version control system that helps you track changes to your code and collaborate with others.

- **Git - the simple guide**: <https://rogerdudler.github.io/git-guide/>

## Installing NIMBLE

[NIMBLE](https://r-nimble.org/) is an R package for Bayesian statistical modeling. Install it by running the following code in R:

```{r}
#| eval: false
install.packages("nimble")
```

After installation, load the package with:

```{r}
#| eval: false
library(nimble)
```
